LM358DR dual operational amplifier.
Texas Instruments Incorporated.
The LM358 family consists of two independent, high-gain, internally frequency-compensated operational amplifiers designed to operate from a single power supply over a wide range of voltages.
Ordering information: LM358DR, SOIC (D) 8-pin, tape and reel.

Absolute Maximum Ratings
Stresses beyond these limits may cause permanent damage. These are stress ratings only, not operating conditions.
Supply voltage, VCC +/-16 V or 32 V
Differential input voltage 32 V
Operating virtual junction temperature 150 C

Recommended Operating Conditions
Supply voltage, VCC (single supply) 3 V to 32 V
Supply voltage, split supply +/-1.5 V to +/-16 V
Operating free-air temperature 0 C to 70 C
